selection_policy: Compare both independent proposals against current catalogs for meaning, naturalness, compactness and consistency. Retain suitable existing wording. Review all five sources in eleven locales. Only the failed-only hint is a new source.
semantic_findings: Generating is allowed when at least one accepted known-ID request remains in progress. It does not mean every request is active.
Needs checking does not itself establish a failed outcome. Ready requires complete success or successful source-only import.
Uncertain hints preserve possibility. They do not promise continued generation or a successful result.

Both proposal rationales characterize the failed hint as partial failure. That rationale is rejected. The state can contain one failed request or all failed requests. Final copy does not assert successful siblings or active work.
Keep the canonical English failed-only hint exactly as requested. Its some is interpreted as an unspecified nonzero number, not proof that other requests succeeded.
Keep existing compact phase labels, including French Génération, German Wird erstellt and Hindi बन रहा है. Fix Simplified Chinese Generating to 生成中.
German catalog register is mixed. These edited recovery hints use informal Prüfe, consistent with existing sign-in and uncertain-result guidance. Broader register cleanup is outside scope.

After Linux CI reported the Spanish Needs checking label clipped at 320px on f96fe1b, select shorter proposal labels for Spanish, German and Brazilian Portuguese. German and Brazilian Portuguese are preventive compactness changes, not observed clipping findings. Other phase labels remain as initially adjudicated.

After Linux CI run 36654720695 reported Italian Generating clipped at 320px on 2a25c75, select In generazione from Gemini, also offered as an Opus rationale fallback. No other translations change in this revision.
